scope: Investigation and strategy; no production workflow or runtime source changes
baseline: Current release.yml and exact recorded source; historic runs are observational, not matched candidate benchmarks
conditions: Classify full, CLI-only, module-only, validation-only, reuse and recovery separately
Record actual runner/tool versions and cache observations; unknown stays unknown
Deduplicate retained successful job executions across attempts
Separate run waiting, execution, transfer, test commands and publication; never sum parallel jobs as elapsed time
structural_adoption: All selected assets retain exact length/digest/target/producer and acceptance binding
Zero unrelated artifact families downloaded by each native consumer
No increase in necessary artifact reads for selected/reused/recovery paths
Rejected alternatives need source-backed rejection, not implementation

future_matched_ci.primary: Dispatch to gate-ready elapsed excluding initial runner wait
secondary: Transferred bytes by consumer and artifact family
future_matched_ci.time_claim_rule: No time-win claim if sample ranges overlap, samples fail, conditions differ, or cache provenance is unknown; increase matched samples or report inconclusive. Two samples do not establish significance or p95.
future_matched_ci.cache: Only add controlled cold/warm comparisons if cache behavior changes

stop_rules: No paid or production load, release/tag/Pages/GHCR writes or workflow dispatch in this investigation
Do not download multi-GB assets to reproduce transient network delays
Reject structurally invalid B/C before prototyping
Keep or defer a candidate if essential platform or native evidence is unavailable
After scoped checks pass, repeat only after changes or unresolved evidence
evidence_policy: Store allowlisted run/job/step/asset metadata and source digests. No credentials, signed blob URLs, task context or full logs.
